1.t: Standing Up in the Milky Way
1.o: The Ship of the Imagination, unfettered by ordinary limits on speed and size, drawn by the music of cosmic harmonies, can take us anywhere in space and time. It has been idling for more than three decades, and yet it has never been overtaken. Its global legacy remains vibrant. Now, it's time once again to set sail for the stars.

2.t: Some of the Things that Molecules Do
2.o: Host Neil deGrasse Tyson is on a voyage to explore the relatedness of all living things and the possible evolution of life in the cosmos. Go on a journey to discover how artificial selection turned the wolf into canine breeds and how natural selection sculpted the complex human eye. Later, Tyson visits the grand Hall of Extinction, a monument to all the broken branches on the tree of life. Retrace the story of life on Earth and the unbroken thread that stretches from the first one-celled organisms to human life.

3.o: There was a time, not so long ago, when natural events could only be understood as gestures of divine displeasure. We will witness the moment that all changed; but first, the Ship of the Imagination is in the brooding, frigid realm of the Oort Cloud, where a trillion comets wait. Our Ship takes us on a hair-raising ride, chasing a single comet through its million-year plunge towards the Sun.

4.o: An exploration of how light, time and gravity combine to distort our perceptions of the universe. We eavesdrop on a series of walks along a beach on summer nights in the year 1809. William Herschel, whose many discoveries include the insight that telescopes are time machines, tells bedtime stories to his young son, John, who will grow up to make some rather profound discoveries of his own.

5.o: The Ship of the Imagination travels back in time to reveal 11th century Europe and North Africa during the golden age of Islam, when brilliant physicist Ibn al-Haytham discovered the scientific method and first understood how we see, and how light travels. Later, William Herschel discovers the infrared and the signature hidden in the light of every star, eventually unlocking one of the keys to the cosmos.

6.o: The Ship of the Imagination ventures on an epic voyage to the bottom of a dewdrop to explore the universe on the smallest scale and observe exotic life forms invisible to the naked eye. Then, host Neil deGrasse Tyson explains the neural network in our brains which determine our sense of smell and memory, and later, he travels deep beneath the surface of the Earth to discover the most mysterious particle we know.

7.o: To determine the true age of the Earth, geochemist Clair Patterson developed the uranium-lead dating method to make an unprecedented discovery – calculating Earth's age of 4.5 billion years. But Patterson's groundbreaking discoveries were just beginning. Patterson made it his mission to draw public attention to the detrimental effects of lead in the environment and dedicated his career to fighting against the petroleum and chemical industry, eventually achieving public health's biggest victory of the 20th century.

8.o: Discover the remarkable story of Annie Jump Cannon and Cecilia Payne, two incredible women who challenged conventional wisdom and uncovered the real-life story of the stars. Cannon led a group of female astronomers in the early 20th century to catalogue the spectral characters of stars, and two decades later, young British beauty Payne joined forces with  Cannon to analyze the data and uncover the chemical compositions of the stars. Later, travel on the Ship of the Imagination to explore the lives and deaths of stars.

9.t: The Lost Worlds of Planet Earth
9.o: The Ship of the Imagination embarks on a journey through space and time to grasp how the autobiography of the Earth is written in its atoms, its oceans, its continents and all living things. Later, American geologist Marie Tharp creates the first true map of Earth’s ocean floor, and discovers microscopic life that exists deep beneath the ocean.

10.o: Travel to 19th century England and meet Michael Faraday, a child of poverty who grew up to invent the motor and the generator. His ideas about electricity and discovery of magnetic fields changed the world and paved the way for future scientists to make giant strides in the world of high technology and instantaneous communication.

11.o: The Ship of the Imagination travels across the cosmos to discover the possibility of beings that live forever and explain why other civilizations perish. Then, visit the Cosmic Calendar of the Future and contemplate what lies ahead with a hopeful vision.

12.o: The Ship of the Imagination travels to our near neighbor Venus, where we begin our journey to discover the long history of global warming and the greenhouse effect. Later, explore the detrimental effects of climate change and trace the magnitude of our impact on the Earth’s atmosphere. However, with knowledge, technology and science within our grasp, imagine a hopeful future where we dedicate our efforts to taking care of our home, Planet Earth.

13.o: The Ship of the Imagination makes a final journey to explore one of the biggest mysteries of the universe: dark energy. Meet one of science's greatest unsung heroes, Fritz Zwicky, whose prediction of supernovas paved the way for our larger understanding of dark energy, the unknown force in the universe that overwhelms gravity on the grandest scale. On our final voyage, discover the romantic message embedded in Voyager's Interstellar Golden Record and contemplate the spiritual experience of life on Earth as our cosmic journey concludes with Carl Sagan's unforgettable meditation, The Pale Blue D

13.o: The team is rerouted to a Colorado lab where they hope to find Dr. Merch.

Cain, Sing, and Blanca quickly take action to save the hostages together with Ash. 2.o: The empress has been murdered: For Ae-sin, words are useless against rapacious foreign powers; she’ll take up arms instead. Eugene gets a new post.

3.o: In an age of imported coffee and fashions, Ae-sin prefers her German gun, but wonders what the English word “love” means and whether Eugene is a friend.

4.o: Suspicions run deep as U.S. troops lose a gun on a train. Ae-sin shows Dong-mae compassion, Hui-seong returns to Joseon, and Eugene considers revenge.

5.o: Ae-sin meets Hui-seong for coffee at the hotel. Eugene deals with Japanese troops at the U.S. legation, and wants to know why Ae-sin defends Joseon.

6.o: Ae-sin gets a new mission. Eugene, Dong-mae and Hui-seong have something in common. Eugene delves into his past, and finally gives Ae-sin his answer.

7.o: Ae-sin learns love’s real meaning and crushes a thug. Emperor Gojong asserts Joseon’s authority. Eugene reveals his Korean name to Ae-sin.

8.o: Despite being advised to lay low as a noble lady, Ae-sin undertakes a dangerous operation. Eugene makes a surprising move and Hui-seong probes his past.

9.o: Eugene wants to know why Ae-sin can’t pull back, but her path is with the Righteous Army. Hui-seong disagrees with Ae-sin and offers an alternative.

10.o: The emperor seeks Eugene’s aid. Hui-seong visits the tailor. Ae-sin feels conflicted after hearing Eugene’s story, but later sees him on a snowy night.

11.o: Ae-sin apologizes to Eugene, but he hopes that she’ll keep fighting for her Joseon. Hui-seong takes a streetcar ride with Ae-sin and proposes a plan.

12.o: Reaffirming her commitment, Ae-sin stands by her decision and settles on an unforeseen pact over castella cake. Eugene investigates an old photograph.

13.o: Ae-sin and Eugene take a ride out to the sea. A nefarious traitor shows great interest in Hui-seong and Eugene. Lord Go Sa-hong meets with Hui-seong.

14.o: Eugene gets devastating news, Dong-mae is apprehended, Ae-sin asks Hina for help and Hui-seong comes to the rescue when Eugene finds himself cornered.

15.o: A disquieting sight vexes Emperor Gojong. Ae-sin defies Lord Go, Eugene refuses to forgive, and Hui-seong visits the Go family estate.

16.o: Hui-seong starts a newspaper and makes a personal sacrifice. Lord Go marshals support, Ae-sin imagines a different life, and Eugene goes to the palace.

17.o: After giving up that which means the most to him, Hui-seong gets a friend a gift. Lord Go leads an urgent appeal, and Ae-sin faces Japanese troops.

18.o: Eugene contends with a viperous imperialist. Seeing Lord Go’s incarceration, Hui-seong publishes a special edition. Ae-sin snubs a Japanese official.

19.o: Lady Ae-sin loses a part of herself. Lord Go counters mounting imperialist schemes, Hui-seong avenges Ae-sin and Emperor Gojong strikes down a snake.

20.o: The Righteous Army retaliates against Japanese troops and Ae-sin seeks justice. War breaks out in Joseon -- and Eugene gets orders to return to the U.S.

21.o: Called an American imperialist, Eugene later asks Ae-sin why she persists in a futile cause. Hui-seong helps Ae-sin out of a bind. An ally joins Ae-sin.

22.o: Emperor Gojong tries to shield the nation but is thrust into an impasse. Finding herself behind the eight ball, Ae-sin concedes that words have power.

23.o: Seeing the explosion, Hui-seong, Dong-mae and Eugene fear the worst. The world’s indifference dismays Emperor Gojong, but Joseon’s defiance gets bolder.

24.o: Joseon remains steadfast. The Righteous Army perseveres on its course. Ae-sin keeps her flame ablaze, while Hui-seong, Dong-mae and Eugene try to help.

1.o: Successful, smart, and stealthy, there is no story that reporter Ban Ji Yeon cannot uncover. When it comes to the matters of the heart, however, she too longs for true love.

2.o: Ji Yeon and Dong Ha can't stop running into each other, and he learns more about her past and desolate love life than she'd like him to know.

3.o: After realizing his age during a steamy encounter, Ji Yeon never wants to see Dong Ha again, but her boss has other plans in mind when she begins receiving threats at the office.

4.o: Ji Yeon ends up staying with Dong Ha after being attacked in her home, and the two decide to take down Kim Jung Do once and for all.

5.o: The employees of Trouble Maker go on a team-building workshop. Ji Yeon learns about Dong Ha's past love.

6.o: Ji Yeon and Dong Ha get into a fight when she replants his hyacinth without permission. Dong Ha helps Ji Yeon prepare for a blind date.

7.o: Shi Hoon returns to Korea, and Ji Yeon's boss wants her to do a story on him. Dong Ha tries to convince Ji Yeon of his feelings.

8.o: Ji Yeon learns the truth about Shi Hoon not showing up to their wedding. Dong Ha struggles with trying to do the right thing.

9.o: Shi Hoon decides to stay in Korea if Ji Yeon will have him. Ji Yeon and Dong Ha try to move on from each other, but lingering feelings keep arising.

10.o: Ji Yeon keeps sending Dong Ha mixed messages, despite her rekindled romance with Shi Hoon. Dong Ha begins drinking and lashing out in frustration.

11.o: Shi Hoon is ready to re-propose to Ji Yeon, but her heart keeps wavering, especially after her recent kiss with Dong Ha.

12.o: With the wedding drawing closer, Dong Ha decides to let Ji Yeon go, but Ji Yeon's not so sure she can do the same to him.

13.o: Shi Hoon makes a life-changing decision. Ji Yeon looks deeper into Han Bit Hospital's past.

14.o: Ji Yeon wants to help Dong Ha and his father reconnect. Na Rae and Min Gu scheme to make Ji Yeon and Dong Ha confess to each other.

15.o: Ji Yeon and Dong Ha begin officially dating. Dong Ha takes a position as Team Leader Byun's assistant in order to be close to Ji Yeon.

16.o: In the series finale, Ji Yeon and Dong Ha's future is uncertain as Ji Yeon must decide if she will participate in the Global Challenge Program.

1.o: Two journalists set out to get the definitive story of infamous serial killer Ted Bundy, as told by the man himself.

2.o: As investigators search for a suspect in the string of brutal murders near Seattle, a woman manages to escape the killer's clutches in Utah.

3.t: Not My Turn to Watch Him
3.o: Following several brazen escapes, Bundy flees to Florida, where he unleashes a wave of atrocities. Also, a simple traffic stop spawns a mystery.

4.o: Bundy's double-murder trial transforms into a bizarre circus with an unhinged ringleader. Later, the accused makes a last-ditch effort to stay alive.

1.o: San Francisco, 1878. Ah Sahm, a newly arrived Chinese immigrant with serious fighting skills, is introduced to Chinatown’s most ruthless tong, the Hop Wei, by Chao, a fixer. After impressing Young Jun, son of tong leader Father Jun, Ah Sahm is branded and taken to a brothel, where he befriends Ah Toy, a courtesan with connections.

2.t: There's No China in the Bible
2.o: Intercepting a shipment of opium at the docks, Young Jun, with Ah Sahm and his Hop Wei lieutenant Bolo in tow, decides to send a message to Long Zii. Big Bill and Lee investigate a grisly murder scene in an alley next to an Irish bar, The Banshee. Penny Blake, the young wife of San Francisco’s mayor, finds herself in a bind while visiting the wharf with her Chinese manservant, Jacob. Ah Sahm pays a steep price for playing the hero. The Long Zii clean up a mess, and brace for more bloodshed.

3.o: Leary pressures gentleman industrialist Byron Mercer, who is Penny’s father, to hire his men for a cable-car track job — despite the fact that Mayor Blake hasn’t yet awarded Mercer the contract. Accused of assault and perhaps worse, Ah Sahm gets a cold shoulder from the Hop Wei, with his fate in the hands of an unexpected ally. Buckley urges Mai Ling to eschew restraint and start a war with the Hop Wei.

4.o: Big Bill finds himself compromised by his gambling excesses, but discovers a possible solution after an opium-den raid. Penny reveals the circumstances that prompted her to marry Mayor Blake, who’s determined to show voters he won’t tolerate San Francisco’s “Yellow Peril.” After meeting with leaders of the Fung Hai tong, Mai Ling offers Ah Sahm a way out of a protracted — and bloody — tong war.

5.o: Transporting precious cargo via stagecoach through the Sierra Nevada, Ah Sahm and Young Jun are forced to spend the night with three strangers at a frontier saloon in the middle of nowhere. The detour turns perilous when Harlan French, a notorious outlaw, shows up with his henchmen, looking for a lucrative payday.

6.t: Chewed Up, Spit Out, and Stepped On
6.o: Tensions escalate between the Hop Wei and Long Zii after an assassination attempt during a boisterous Chinatown parade. Big Bill sets out to pay his debt to Jack Damon, leaving Lee to keep watch over Lucy and the kids. Mayor Blake and Deputy Mayor Buckley get a mandate from Robert Crestwood, a senator with eyes on the White House.

7.o: Ah Sahm faces a dilemma when Father Jun sends Bolo to hunt down Long Zii and Mai Ling . Ah Toy recruits a special girl from a whore monger, and takes on a business partner for a land deal. Penny is faced with an unsavory choice in order to save her home. Lee’s past catches up with him.

8.t: They Don't Pay Us Enough to Think
8.o: After a bloodbath on the streets of Chinatown, the Hop Wei and Long Zii consider a novel way to end hostilities. Ah Toy and her real-estate business partner, Leonard Patterson, hit a fork in the road in their effort to buy a valuable piece of land. After promising jobs to Leary’s Irish workers, Mercer toasts Crestwood at a fundraiser, while Penny struggles to hold her tongue. Mai Ling warns her brother against waging a battle he may not win.

9.o: Chinatown gathers to witness a “prize fight” between elite warriors from the Hop Wei and Long Zii. Buckley plays a bluff in hopes of getting Mercer to lower his fee. Ah Sahm remembers his roots as a fighter, as Ah Toy warns him of the dangers that await. Bill and Lee question Wang Chao about the recent series of sword killings in San Francisco.

10.t: If You're Going to Bow, Bow Low
10.o: Ah Sahm rejects his warrior roots and retreats into the netherworld of the Chinese working class. A guilty Big Bill stands vigil for Lee at the hospital. With the police roughing up tong members in retaliation for their violence, Zing and the Fung Hai make a show of force to compel Mai Ling to honor her partnership. Burned by Buckley, Leary decides to take matters into his own hands at Mercer's factory. Seeking to snap Ah Sahm out of his funk, Chao shares a harrowing story of personal hardship. Ah Toy preaches a not-so-ancient message to Ah Sahm: In the middle of chaos lies opportunity. Season

1.t: Learn to Endure, or Hire a Bodyguard
1.o: Back with the Hop Wei, Ah Sahm spends his nights at the Barbary Coast fight pit, confronting a new anti-Chinese group, Teddy’s Boys. While Ah Toy accuses him of just looking for another fight, an empowered Mai Ling worries about her brother’s next steps. Meanwhile, Bill finds it hard to break out of his role as enforcer for Zing; Penny is determined to continue running Mercer Steel, much to Blake’s dismay; and Chao offers Ah Sahm some advice for his future with Young Jun.

2.o: Ah Sahm and Young Jun search for a discreet place to hide their product after striking a deal with a new opium supplier. As Lee becomes increasingly dependent on laudanum, he and Bill continue to investigate the swordsman murders. Mai Ling sends Li Yong and Zing to deliver a message to a rival tong. Penny asks for Ah Sahm’s help in protecting her factory. Sophie continues to pique Leary’s interest. Ah Toy receives a visit from Nellie Davenport, a wealthy widow committed to ending the exploitation of Chinese women.

3.o: With their new enterprise going well, Young Jun shares his worries with Ah Sahm about the new men Father Jun has brought over from China, and later, the partners are impressed by Hong, an enthusiastic recruit with a secret. Meanwhile, Chao goes to Mai Ling for help keeping Zing away from his business, Sophie grows closer to Leary, Nellie’s politics raise questions from her peers, and things take a deadly turn at Bill’s home.

4.t: If You Don't See Blood, You Didn't Come to Play
4.o: As the police prepare for retribution, Chao comes to Bill with a mutually beneficial proposal. A sympathetic Sophie offers Leary a new plan. Ah Sahm and Penny have a moment when he confides his plans for the future. Buckley urges Blake to take a stand against the Chinese, Lee seeks to ease his pain, Mai Ling invests in a legitimate business, and Nellie urges Ah Toy to imagine a different kind of life for her sex workers.

5.t: Not for a Drink, a F*ck, or a G**damn Prayer
5.o: A guilty Mai Ling tries to make things right with Ah Sahm, who’s more intent than ever on seeking revenge. Penny finds her business in trouble and learns that Ah Sahm has been using her. Leary gets a warning and offers one of his own. Ah Toy pays an emotional visit to Nellie’s Sonoma winery. Bill and Chao put their plot against the Fung Hai into action.

6.t: To a Man with a Hammer, Everything Looks Like a Nail
6.o: Ah Sahm, Young Jun, and Hong travel with Vega to Rooker’s Mill, a U.S.-Mexico border town owned by Elijah Rooker, the wealthy host of a lucrative fight tournament that Ah Sahm is determined to win. As he learns more about Vega, Ah Sahm draws the attention of another fighter, Dolph, and later, Rooker himself.

7.t: If You Wait by the River Long Enough
7.o: Change is afoot for the Hop Wei after Father Jun, Ah Sahm, and Young Jun face off. Ah Toy decides that Nellie may be the answer to her problems and takes matters at a sadistic rival brothel into her own hands. Leary is urged by both Buckley and Sophie to utilize his political influence. Just as his heroics are trumpeted, Bill is faced with another swordsman murder. A fatal clash unfolds at the Blake household.

8.o: The police shut down Chinatown in their hunt for a killer, just as the Hop Wei make a move that puts Mai Ling on edge. Buckley steps into a new role and considers a proposition from Leary, who faces questions from the Irish workingmen. Ah Toy fights for her life, while Chao faces a major dilemma.

9.o: After Bill and his men are confronted by an angry mob, Chinatown erupts into chaos, forcing the tongs to work together to protect their streets. As Chao and Mai Ling seek shelter, Mai Ling tends to an ailing Ah Toy. Sophie opens her eyes to Leary's world. Lee decides which side he's on.

10.o: Young Jun faces a crucial decision after Mai Ling tries to drive a wedge between him and Ah Sahm, who has emerged as a hero in Chinatown and takes the opportunity to go on the offensive against Leary. Determined to take Buckley down, Penny goes to the press. Bill reckons with what he's become, and Lee seeks out a familiar face. Mai Ling finally plays her hand against the Hop Wei.

1.t: Exactly the Wrong Time to Get Proud
1.o: Struggling under the pressure of an increased police presence, the Hop Wei search for a new, lucrative way to survive.

2.t: Anything Short of a Blow to the Head
2.o: As Ah Sahm and Young Jun struggle to produce authentic bills, they get valuable printing advice from an unexpected source.

3.o: While taking menacing steps to secure Nellie's land, Strickland instills confidence in Leary's political abilities.

4.t: In Chinatown, No One Thinks About Forever
4.o: Shaken by the loss of Nellie's land, Ah Toy grapples with a difficult choice. Ah Sahm and Yan Mi think on their toes during a police raid.

5.t: Whiskey and Sticky and All the Rest Can Wait
5.o: Ah Sahm and Hong race against time to free a captured Young Jun before he's sent back to China. Meanwhile, an imprisoned Mai Ling hits rock bottom.

6.t: A Soft Heart Won't Do You No Favors
6.o: Chao and Lee band together after an unexpected tossup threatens their lives. Meanwhile, the Hop Wei navigate a tense deal with German traders.

7.t: Gotta Be Crooked to Get Along in a Crooked World
7.o: In the wake of Father Jun's injury, Young Jun steps up for the Hop Wei. Leary struggles to smooth over rising working-class tensions.

8.t: You Know When You're Losing a Fight
8.o: As Mai Ling's wedding briefly unites the Hop Wei and Long Zii, Li Yong receives a grim final warning from Kong Pak.

9.t: All of Death Is a Going Home
9.o: Ah Sahm makes a bold sacrifice to protect Yan Mi, Mai Ling reckons with the consequences of her actions, and Leary reaches his breaking point.

10.o: As the Secret Service finally corners the Tongs' printing operation, Ah Sahm must choose between his brothers in the Hop Wei and a future with Yan Mi.

1.o: Soon after a rare chickeraffe goes missing from the Glurfsburg Zoo, Sam and Guy meet by chance at a diner, setting off a series of extraordinary events.

2.o: Guy shows up to return Sam's briefcase, only to learn he's got company. Elsewhere, a mother-daughter duo begins a very slow drive through the desert.

3.o: With the Bad Guys in pursuit, Sam and Guy board a train to Meepville and meet Michellee, a cautious bean counter, and her thrill-seeking daughter, E.B.

4.o: Taking a detour to find the chickeraffe some food, Guy and Sam cross paths with an egg-loving fox who's working hard to control his appetite.

5.o: While seeking shelter for the night, the trio gets stuck in a junkyard. The only upside for an inventor like Guy? It's full of raw materials.

6.o: Panic hits the streets of Prinz Pazookle when the locals learn there's a chickeraffe in town. But a colorful carnival is bringing everyone together.

7.o: A singing rodent comes to the rescue in North Shvizelton when Sam and Guy wind up in jail with no real plan to get themselves out.

8.o: To escape the Bad Guys -- and stormy weather -- Sam and friends spend the night in Michellee's cabin, but trouble follows. Snerz hires outside help.

9.o: Guy and Sam need a next-level plan when Snerz's animal-napper chases them up a cliff. As for the Bad Guys, they're definitely down -- but not out.

10.o: The fugitive friends make a stop in Stovepipe Junction, where Sam gets to meet Guy's family -- and reveals a shocking secret.

11.o: Just as Guy's about to try a bite of breakfast, the Bad Guys bust in with the truth about their mission. Under the sea, the plot thickens.

12.o: After a close call on the docks, Guy gets captured and learns he's been duped. Michellee gives her daughter a tour of Meepville.

13.o: The SnerzDay Gala sets the stage for a surprise ending that's full of twists and turns -- and a heartwarming act of true friendship.

1.o: Burned out at her job and taken for granted at home, a working mom suspects her partner is cheating, so she tells a lie to win back his attentions.

2.o: Patrick makes a grand gesture toward Elvira that sends Brigitte reeling. When Carole winds up at a police station, her father gives her a wake-up call.

3.o: Elvira's "test results" arrive in the mail. Niklas discovers Sam's secret. Patrick is faced with temptation. Carole makes a confession to her mother.

4.o: Pretending to go to the hospital for surgery, Elvira travels to a place from her past. Meanwhile, her family learns Virginie has been keeping a secret.

5.o: An explosive washing machine introduces Elvira to some mysterious neighbors. Brigitte notices something strange about Elvira's prescription records.

6.o: After Patrick tells the children the truth, Elvira tries to explain to them why she lied. Lorenzo arrives in town, looking for Maria Magdalena.

1.o: Weeks have passed. From an upstairs window at a neighbor's home, exiled Elvira sees new love interests and new faces entering her family members' lives.

2.o: To win back her job, Elvira embarks on a mission that unexpectedly brings her face to face with Lorenzo. Renan asks for Sam's thoughts about his book.

3.o: Lorenzo demands answers from Elvira, who recalls her youth to address them. Sam learns Renan has been seeing his ex. Carole makes a pass at Lorenzo.

4.o: With some help, Elvira escapes captivity and arrives at her family's Christmas dinner, only to discover Sandrine — and later, Lorenzo — have also come.

5.o: Months later, Elvira and her family are being pulled in different directions by new homes, relationships and aspirations, until a loss reunites them.

6.o: The sect makes a demand of Carole. Renan extends an invitation to Sam. Elvira confesses to Patrick the rest of the truth about Lorenzo's origins.

1.o: Pressured by his father and mocked by his peers, 15-year-old Tiuri competes to become a Knight of Dagonaut - just as the kingdom faces a dark threat.

2.o: With the Red Riders and Novices hot on his trail, Tiuri makes his way to Mistrinaut, where the mayor's daughter takes a keen interest in his mission.

3.t: At the End of the World
3.o: The Red Riders drive their captives high into the snowy mountains. Caught in a storm, Tiuri and Lavinia take shelter inside an ominous monastery.

4.o: On a ship headed toward Unauwen, Tiuri and Lavinia meet a mysterious passenger who seems to know the secret of Tiuri's past - and his destiny.

5.o: Ardanwen guides the group to an eerily empty town. Lavinia helps Tiuri practice controlling his powers. A startling discovery divides the Novices.

6.o: As the Blood Moon nears and Viridian prepares for his homecoming, Tiuri and friends wrestle with doubt, betrayal and a daunting final test.

1.o: High school teacher Ibuki Hiiragi takes his class hostage, setting off a bomb in the school and demanding to know the truth about a student's suicide.
Harmony leads to heartache as aspiring singer Bailey's big break falls to pieces. But a chance encounter on a stormy night leads to new possibilities.

2.o: As Bailey settles in over breakfast, Dylan kick-starts his career as her new manager. Will a last-minute audition lead to stardom... or serious drama?

3.o: Beau and the kids get cleaned up for a church wedding — and encounter an unexpected guest at the house. Meanwhile, Cassidy struggles with her faith.

4.o: Bailey and the Haywoods make the best of bittersweet news as Beau prepares to replace his late wife's mare. Brody reconnects with an old friend.

5.o: While Tuck and Brody struggle with sibling rivalry, Bailey struggles to balance a big audition and a LeAnn Rimes concert with Cassidy.

6.o: Beau and Summer's relationship takes center stage after she asks him to spend the night. Elsewhere, Brody and Tuck prepare for a double date night.

7.t: You're Nobody Till Somebody Loves You
7.o: On the heels of exciting news, Bailey struggles to keep her past out of her present and future. Meanwhile, Beau navigates a bad case of heartache.

8.o: Boone's big ask leads to a big answer. The following morning, Beau tries to minimize his birthday, much to the dismay of Bailey and the kids.

9.o: It's lights, camera, action for Bailey as a Rocky Top Records film crew stops by the ranch… and encounters a less-than-cinematic day of disaster.

10.o: Bailey's time to shine finally arrives - but the Haywoods aren't ready to say goodbye. Brody revisits his feelings for Jo, and Boone drops a bombshell.

1.o: As Ghazal quarrels with the powerful man El Khedewy, he crashes into her car, and she reports him to the police. They reconcile afterward as he admires her bold and strong personality. As Ghazal's husband, Abed, returns from Paris, he hits her because of her frequent staying up late.

2.o: As Ghazal tells her family that she wants a divorce because of Abed's physical abuse of her, they refuse because he gives them a lot of money. When she goes to Abed to tell him that she wants a divorce, he hits her. El Khedewy's son is kidnapped.

3.o: Ghazal tries to kill Abed, but he catches her and hits her. As she complains to her family to help her get divorced, her brother hits her. Ghazal decides to enlist the help of El Khedewy to kill Abed. El Khedewy trains his brother to become a powerful thug like him.

4.o: As El Khedewy asks Ghazal for time to think about killing her husband, he tells her that Abed is monitoring her phone. As Talaat moves into an apartment above Qadryia's apartment, it causes tension for her. El Khedewy raids Ghazal's apartment, holding a knife.

5.o: As Ghazal escapes with El Khedewy from Abed after discovering that he has incited El Khedewy to kill her, she asks the latter to help her. It's revealed that Nadine is in a relationship with Abed. Malik is arrested for beating a young man in a bar.

6.o: Though Nadine and Abed have a customary marriage, Nadine is also in a relationship with Emad. Malik is released. As Abed plans with Rifaat to kidnap Ghazal from the ranch, Rifaat tells Qadryia that El Khedewy is cheating on her on the ranch, so she goes there.

7.o: After El Khedewy manages to rescue Ghazal from being kidnapped and takes her back to the farm, he enlists Malik's help to kidnap Abu Khater for questioning. As they go through with the plan, one of Abu Khater's men threatens Malik with a weapon, leading El Khedewy to back down.

8.o: As Abu Khater confesses on Rifaat, El Khedewy goes to him afterward. On Abed's orders, Nadine comes to visit Ghazal at the ranch to interrogate her.

9.o: As Abed gives Ghazal's family a few hours to get Ghazal back, otherwise, he will throw them out of their homes, they contact her through Nadine, and she thinks about returning, but El Khedewy stops her.

10.o: As Abu Khater’s father attacks El Khedewy's ranch, his men attack his home, but the police take control of the situation, and El Khedewy controls the situation on his ranch.

11.o: As Ghazal tells Abed that she and El Khedewy are in love, he tells her that she's condemning him to death. When Malik sees Rifaat with Qadryia, he informs El Khedewy about it, so he divorces her.

12.o: As El Khedewy takes part in a smuggling operation, Officer Mahmoud finds out about it, but he can not catch El Khedewy. Hind gets closer to Ziad. Nadine denies her relationship with Emad.

13.o: Abed asks Malik to secretly protect him and his property, and El Khedewy also asks him to monitor Officer Mahmoud El Rehabi.

14.o: As Emad learns of Abed's marriage to Nadine, he tries to use her to get to his money. As El Khedewy kidnaps Ghazal when she escapes from Abed, they go to the ranch, but he tells her that it is a temporary situation.

15.o: As Qadryia sends Zagrouta to beat Ghazal, she ends up beating Mafatin instead, who is taken to the hospital in a critical condition. As Abed uses Malik to find out where Ghazal is by luring him in with money, he finds El Khedewy before him.

16.o: As Malik exposes Abed to El Khedewy, he falls into his trap and forbids him from taking Ghazal. Abed sets up a trap for Ghazal through Sama as she goes to meet her with El Khedewy, who gets shot.

17.o: It's revealed that Rifaat and Abu Khater were behind El Khedewy's shooting, but he is rescued. Ziad admits to Hind that he has feelings for her. Malik tries to get closer to Noha, the sister of Officer Mahmoud. Zagrouta is arrested.

18.o: When El Khedewy stops an operation of smuggling weapons for Abed, he makes him choose between losing his merchandise or divorcing Ghazal, so he surrenders and divorces her. Ghazal is arrested on charges of drug trafficking.

19.o: It's revealed that Abed was the one who planted the drugs to Ghazal in her bag through a guard. After his release, El Khedewy goes to the guard to testify in favor of Ghazal, but he is late for the trial, and Ghazal is sentenced to seven years in prison.

20.o: El Khedewy tries to figure out a way to get Ghazal released from prison. Hind tries to get back with Nader after Ziad's departure, but he refuses. Nadine asks Abed to publicly announce their marriage.

21.o: As Qadryia asks Ghazal to stay away from El Khedewy, he clashes with her, so she decides to leave him and get closer to Rifaat. El Khedewy decides to forget Ghazal, as his work is affected because of her.

22.o: As Officer Mahmoud helps El Khedewy by informing him of the whereabouts of Abed's henchman, he takes him to the prosecution office and he testifies in favor of Ghazal, and she is released. As Nadine informs Abed about the date of Ghazal's wedding to El Khedewy, he sends his men to kill him.

23.o: Abed retracts from killing El Khedewy and Ghazal at the last minute whose wedding takes place. Ghazal asks El Khedewy to change his line of work. Qadryia marries Rifaat after El Khedewy got married. Abed tells Nadine that he will announce their marriage.

24.o: As Abed's psychological condition deteriorates, he commits suicide with a gun. Ziad tells Hind that he knew about her relationship with Nader, so he walked away from her. El Khedewy begins to take revenge on his enemies.

25.o: Everyone is being investigated about Abed’s suicide. As Nadine and Emad are happy about Abed’s death, considering that his wealth will be transferred to her, it's revealed that Abed transferred all of his wealth to Ghazal before his death.

26.o: As El Khedewy takes his children from Qadryia because of Rifaat’s bad treatment of them, she demands from Rifaat to return them to her. When Malik tells El Khedewy that he loves Mahmoud El Rehabi’s sister, he asks him to stay away from her at once.

27.o: Rifaat and his men plot to kill Malik. Emad kidnaps his son from Howaida, then returns him to his mother without informing him. Mahmoud rejects Noha's relationship with Malik.

28.o: El Khedewy sets out to take revenge on the person who slaughtered Malik, much to Ghazal's objection. Sherif, Abed's lawyer, tells both Nadine and Emad that Abed's remaining fortune is only EGP 120,000.

29.o: As El Khedewy receives a message stating that Mina is Malik's killer, he kills Mina. Ghazal leaves the house after her abortion because of El Khedewy's beating of her, then he reconciles with her and she returns to him. As Nadine becomes seriously ill, she decides to repent.

30.o: After Qadryia tells El Khedewy that Rifaat is the mastermind behind killing Malik with the help of Hamza and Abu Khater, he kills them all, then decides to travel with Ghazal, but the police catch him and kill him. Ghazal begins her life again after having Abed's wealth.

1.o: This episode starts with the sudden apperance of a mysterious pillar of light.  The city is thrown into a blackout, but quickly recovers.  We are then taken to a bathroom, where we hear several girls talking about an angel of death, Boogipop.  Moto Tonomura remembers about a time when she still hated herself.  This entire episode is a flashback.

2.o: This episode is told from Hisashi Jonouchi.  He is running from someone...rather, something.  He sees a strange bug in the alley way and eats it.  He flashesback to when he first started seeing the bugs.  They were spiders, over people's hearts.  Only he could see them.  Once he removed the spider, that person forgot about what made them sorrowful.  However, Jonouchi grew an addiction for the spiders and started to crave for more and more.  The episode ends with Jonouchi having an encounter with Boogiepop Phantom, where he is 'taken'.

3.o: This episode revolves around Misuzu.  She had a friend a while ago, named Panaru.  Panaru had a great loving for the world, but was killed by a serial killer.  Misuzu then decided to take up Panaru's love, only it was not a true love that Misuzu had.  By accepting everything, she opened herself to another entity, who manipulated her into luring Naghi Kirima to a location.  However, Boogiepop Phantom prevented the meeting.  Misuzu found herself in an allyway, where she met her doom.

4.o: This episode is from Yoji Suganuma's point of view.  He's mainly a loser a school, and only has his online buddies as friends.  He is also a dating sim game addict, and has fallen in love with a girl named Rie (Ree-ae) who is actually just bits of data on his computer.  He becomes addicted to 'Type-S' a so-called attraction device.  A girl who applied to work at the resturant with him starts to look more and more like Rie, until the line of reality is forever blurred to Yoji.

5.o: This episode is quite a confusing one.  It jumps from POV to POV, and the time is frequently changing.  It mainly takes place in a police station, and is all about a conversation between Morita and another cop.  Every time we return to the conversation, a little bit more is revealed, until at the end, we start all over again.

6.o: This episode revolves around Shizue, who died about 5 years ago.  A girl named Rika shares the diaries of Shizue and herself with Shizue's mother.  The diaries reveal much more about Shizue than her mother could have ever thought.

7.t: Until Ure In My Arms Again
7.o: This episode revolves around a brother and a sister, who usually stick together, yet the brother is slowly rejecting the sister.  The brother recently (after the pillar of light) developed a want to unassemble everything and remove the useless parts.  When he thinks that Paisely Park is useless, he attempts to take it apart, yet relizes that he doesn't have any powers.  His sister has the power to grant his wishes.

8.o: This episode mainly revolves around Nagi Kirima, yet is told from the POV of Ichiro Kishida.  He knew Nagi in the past, but he adopted a new alias and reentered her life as Ichiro Kishida.  They go on a mission to stop the Manticore, a flesh eating shape shifter.  They run into Boogiepop Phantom, who destroys the Manticore.  However, the Manticore isn't gone forever...

9.o: This episode revolves around three people, the first of which is Saki, a pianist.  She is determined to make it into a music university, but she just can't make it.  Then, Poom Poom gives her a balloon.  After she let go of it, she killed herself.  Quite a few people are now getting strange phone calls urgeing them to 'Come play with us.'  Yoshiki, the one making the calls, gets taken in by Boogiepop Phantom and dissapears.

10.o: This episode revolves around Poom Poom, Manaka, and Paisely Park.  More and more people are getting red balloons, making Nagi go to the park to see what's causing it.  There are children versions there of everyone that had recieved a balloon.  However, Boogiepop (not the phantom) arrives on the scene and causes Manaka to fall from the Ferris Wheel.  All the lights in the park go out, and Manaka appears to have aged quite a bit.  Apparantly, her powers made her age, and now that she used them like crazy, she aged greatly.  All the phantom children dissapear, along with Poom Poom, leaving Manaka

11.o: This episode revolves around Manaka.  It explains about her past, her mother, her grandmother, and her ability.  After the flashbacks are done, Manaka starts to run from Boogiepop when Boogiepop Phantom interveins and tries to kill her.  Boogipop frees her, stating that she hasn't enough power to cause a threat to this world, and Manaka runs off to the house of mirrors.  Boogiepop finally meets Boogiepop Phantom.  Manaka tells herself that she will not die; rather, she will become light.  And so she does.  A great light composed of the golden butterfiles engulfs the land, causing time to skip.

12.o: One year after the 11th episode, these events occur.  Toka is going to take an entrance exam when she detects trouble.  Indeed, as the manticore is still alive; it possessed the writer when the manticore was originally destroyed by Boogiepop Phantom.  Boogipop comes and destroys both the manticore and the writer, who had actually died a long time ago.  Boogiepop then says, ""I feel sorry for Toka Miashta.  She was supposed to be taking an entrance exam now.""  Thus the series comes to the end, with us only just knowing who Boogiepop really was.

1.o: Parker Schnabel and his friends pay tribute to the legends before them and attempt the Klondike Trail of 1897. Not only is it 600 miles of mountains, lakes and rivers, but leaving dangerously late in the season means the winter may derail their plans.

2.o: Parker and his crew are only 50 miles into the daunting 600 mile trek on the Klondike Trail. It's a race against time as the water is quickly freezing, but with food sources running low they are forced to pause and go hunting or face starvation.

3.o: With 375 miles to go, their journey takes an unexpected turn when Parker falls into freezing water and jeopardizes the entire expedition.

4.o: Parker and his friends relive the toughest journey of their lives. They reveal the struggle, conflict and secrets about how close they came to disaster.

1.t: Pastry Pesto Chicken, 'Nduja Vongole & Sausage Bake
1.o: Jamie rustles up some flaky pastry pesto chicken, a sausage bake, a spicy 'nduja vongole, and a watermelon granita

2.t: Sticky Wings, Sirloin Steak & Garlic Mushroom Pasta
2.o: Jamie makes some succulent sticky kickin' chicken wings, a sizzling sirloin with awesome aubergines, creamy garlic mushroom pasta, and rum 'n' raisin ice cream

3.t: Thai-Style Sea Bass, Garlicky Mushrooms & Sweet Chicken Suprise
3.o: On the menu this time: Thai-style crispy sea bass, baked garlicky mushrooms, a sweet chicken surprise, and pineapple carpaccio

4.t: Mustardy Beef, Saffron Rice & Salmon Nicoise
4.o: Jamie makes a meltin' mustardy beef that uses only five ingredients. There's also a totally foolproof baked saffron rice, steamed salmon niçoise, and plum tarte tatin.

5.t: Chorizo Salmon, Potato Artichoke Al Forno & Lamb Hotpots
5.o: Jamie cooks four tasty dishes using just five ingredients - a smoky chorizo salmon; potato and artichoke al forno; lovely lamb hotpot; and a Walnut-Whip affogato

6.t: Chickpea Chard Pork, Egg-Fried Rice, Beef Carpaccio & Fish Pie
6.o: Jamie cooks up chickpea and chard pork - a hearty one-pan wonder. There's a brilliant egg fried rice; beef carpaccio with Egyptian spice; and Jamie's crazy-simple fish pie.

7.t: Lamb Kofta Flatbreads, Broad Bean Salad & Peanut Chicken
7.o: Jamie cooks up some spicy lamb kofta flatbreads, a Spanish broad bean salad with manchego, peanut chicken satay, and peach and almond Alaska

8.t: Chicken Noodle Stir-Fry, Pappa Al Pomodoro Soup & Lemon Sole
8.o: Jamie makes a chicken noodle stir fry, a rustic tomato soup, a crispy-skin lemon sole that's a one-pan wonder, and a honey berry filo smash for a spectacular pudding

1.o: Jan Michelsen is investigating the disappearance of a young woman called Julie Vinding from a Copenhagen suburb. Six months later, Jan is the only one who believes that she is still alive.  Jan finds a ten-year-old case from the same neighbourhood where a 17-year-old girl, Natasha, disappeared on her way home from a party. Jan discovers the remains of Natasha in a lake. She was murdered. Suspecting a link between the two crimes, Jan brings in an expert on serial killers, Louise Bergstein.

2.o: Jan and Louise’s investigation into Natasha’s death leads them to suspect Anders Kjeldsen, a man who has been arrested before for violent crimes including rape. Trapped in a basement, Emma tries to comfort a traumatised Julie, but soon needs comforting herself.

3.o: Jan and Louise find an unsolved murder case in Sweden that has similarities with Natasha's, although this one has an unusual signature: the victim's ring finger was cut off. Louise doesn't believe that the murder has been committed by Anders Kjeldsen.  Meanwhile, on a farm that Anders Kjeldsen stayed at as a child, the police make a gruesome discovery. Stine is forced to help Anders with the women in the basement, who are planning to escape.

4.o: Louise realises that Anders Kjeldsen does not kill alone but has a partner who is the dominant of the two. In the basement, Emma tries to persuade Stine to help her to escape.

5.o: Jan and Louise find a dress belonging to Natasha – the first victim – which Anders Kjeldsen had hidden. That same night, Anders tries to kidnap another woman. Stine Velin attends her big brother Mikkel's 40th birthday party and reveals a dark family secret.

6.o: The public appeal for information on Anders Kjeldsen leads to the identification of the third victim from the farm and an explanation of how all the women met their killer. Louise suspects he has a female accomplice.

7.o: Stine Velin is taken into police custody, but insists that she is also one of Anders Kjeldsen’s victims and does not know where either Anders or Emma are.

8.o: Jan and Louise find Anders Kjeldsen. Louise fears that Stine’s family is in danger and places them in a safe house.

1.o: Five years ago, Alice Ejbye's 18-year-old son Markus was murdered by a serial killer who was never found. Alice is now seriously ill and asks criminal profiler, Louise Bergstein, the daughter of her best friend, to help solve the case. At the same time, elsewhere on Funen, a man named Peter Vinge receives a fatal message from his wife Masja.

2.o: A young man has been found in the woods, tortured and stabbed to death. Profiler Louise Bergstein and the head of the investigation Karina Horup try to find evidence for whether the murder can be attributed to a serial killer who, after a five-year hiatus, may now be active again. They slowly work their way towards the killer's highly unusual motive. Meanwhile, Peter Vinge struggles with being a single parent to his son, Johannes, and looks for his next victim.

3.o: Louise Bergstein and Karina Hørup discover that the serial killer has a claimed a new victim, William Fjeldby, who was kidnapped and abducted in his own car. William's father, multimillionaire Gorm Fjeldby, clings to the hope that his son has been kidnapped for a ransom and is therefore still alive. As the police search for William, Peter Vinge tries to celebrate Johannes's birthday without Masja. It dawns on Johannes that his father is hiding something from him.

4.o: Alice Ejbye receives some bad news from the doctor. At the same time, despite two new victims, the police have yet to find the man who killed her son Markus. Desperate, Alice posts a video on social media offering a reward which has consequences for her relationship with Louise. The police are inundated with information from people who are after the reward, and Karina and Louise struggle to determine whether there is anything useful among all the information. Peter takes his frustration out on his next victim.

5.o: Seven weeks after Alice's death, Louise is in mourning and wants to go home as Karina issues her with an ultimatum regarding the case. Alice's death raises a new suspicion which takes the investigation in a new direction. Peter Vinge focuses on his work at a local sawmill, where he receives an unexpected offer from Leif. At the same time, Peter is in conflict with Johannes who remains in a stage of teenage revolt against his father.

6.o: Louise Bergstein continues to assist the investigation to find the serial killer, who now has six brutal murders to his name. With Karina Hørup, Louise returns to the first victims in an attempt to find out where they may have met their killer. Peter notices that the police are closer to him than ever before, and at the same time happens to meet Louise again.

7.o: Unaware of who he really is, Louise gets far too close to Peter. But the terrible truth lurks beneath the surface. Karina tries to find new evidence for the investigation on her own, and an earlier clue resurfaces, moving the case forward. Peter sorts his life out and gives Johannes a message that his son has a hard time coming to terms with.

8.o: The police take Johannes to the station, and Louise fears that the truth about her and Peter Vinge will be revealed. Meanwhile, Peter meets his ex-wife Masja, who has returned from Singapore without notice in order to set things straight. Karina, Søren and Torben desperately try to find Peter before he can claim another victim.

1.o: Louise is determined to continue working as a profiler and when a couple is found brutally murdered, she takes on the case. She assists Detective Inspector Frederik Havgaard, who believes he knows who the killer is.

2.o: Louise locates Bjørn’s little sister Maria. Maria's caseworker suggests that Louise mentor the young woman, who is faced with the prospect of having her child taken away from her. Meanwhile, Bjørn is in hiding.

3.o: The police hunt for Bjørn is intensified. Following a search of Pelle’s home, Frederik and Louise uncover truths about Bjørn’s past, and a decision is reached on the forced removal of Maria’s child.

4.o: Another crime is committed. Frederik is convinced that Bjørn is the perpetrator, but Louise's investigations point to a different suspect. Bjørn turns to Louise and shares a secret with her that might close the case.

5.o: Three years on, Louise has moved to Aarhus to make a fresh start, but the past catches up with her when she meets Frederik again. He involves her in a new case in which a disabled woman has been found dead. Frederik thinks she was murdered, and the ensuing investigation seems to suggest that the dead body is a part of a larger pattern.

6.o: Louise and Frederik discover a connection between Bjørn and Alberte, who both grew up in the Breidablik commune. Louise visits the commune undercover in order to assist the police in their investigation and quickly notices the charismatic leader, Jon, who has a special relationship with Alberte.

7.o: Louise tries to get closer to Jon. Alberte becomes jealous and challenges Louise’s cover story. Meanwhile, Frederik discovers that one of Jon's old friends, who also owned Breidablik, perished in a mysterious fire.

8.o: Louise and Frederik put pressure on Jon to accept responsibility for his actions, but once again he takes advantage of his relationship with Alberte. Louise decides to confront the past.

1.t: Not All Neighbors Are Good Neighbors
1.o: In search of a new beginning, Lee Eun-pyo moves into a new apartment. She finds a note left by a former tenant to beware of Kim Yu-bin's mom.

2.t: Adults Don't Make Friends Without Motives
2.o: Eun-pyo grows anxious when she sees her son, Jung Dong-seok, being disruptive in class. Byeon Chun-hui is appointed head of the PTA.

3.t: That Dawn Before the Day Breaks
3.o: When Eun-pyo overhears that her son has been blacklisted by the school community, she decides to leave the neighborhood.

4.o: Eun-pyo tries to get Dong-seok into Yu-bin's group for the Rube Goldberg Competition. Seo Jin-ha's son, Henry Benuel, joins an opposing team.

5.t: An Ill-Fated Match Made in Heaven
5.o: At the art exhibit, Eun-pyo encounters someone she was hoping to avoid and Jin-ha meets someone who reminds her of her painful past.

6.o: As tragedy stirs the community, everyone tries to find out what happened while covering up their own tracks. Eun-pyo discovers a mysterious note.

7.o: As rumors grow more rampant, the moms are called to attend a group session at school. Jung Jae-ung faces hard truths as his wife's past comes to light.

8.o: Seeing that the case may soon come to a close, Jae-ung moves quickly to find the real cause of death. More gossip bubbles beneath the surface.

9.o: To protect her family and to climb the social ladder, Eun-pyo banks on Dong-seok's abilities. Kim Yeong-mi begins to suspect her husband.

10.t: Wind From the Tip of a Sword
10.o: Upon receiving a tip from an informant, Louis Benuel brings in Chun-hui and Lee Man-su for questioning. Dong-seok appears on a TV show for gifted kids.

11.t: The Sins We Did Not Find Out About
11.o: Dong-seok sees a child therapist. Chun-hui deals with Yu-bin's unusual behavior. Eun-pyo reaches out to the one person who can help her son feel better.

12.t: Can Adults Become Friends Without Motives Too?
12.o: Eun-pyo makes peace with a mom who is on the same boat as her. Chun-hui faces growing financial pressure. Yeong-mi discovers a secret folder.

13.o: Eun-pyo turns to Chun-hui with shocking news. When Chun-hui advises her to stay put and be quiet, it only fuels Eun-pyo's drive to expose the truth.

14.o: Chun-hui gives her husband an ultimatum, but struggles to find a way to support her family alone. Jin-ha's housekeeper entrusts Eun-pyo with a secret.

15.o: While out for drinks, Park Yun-ju witnesses a shady scene. When a message arrives on Jae-ung's phone, Eun-pyo makes an irrevocable decision.

16.o: Brought in for questioning by the police, Chun-hui names who she thinks is the real suspect. Henry makes a devastating confession to his father.

1.o: Allegra auditions to join the Eleven O' Clock music hall company behind Caterina's back. Caterina, her mother, doesn't want her to be part of that world. When she finds out the truth, they have a fight. Allegra meets her grandmother Cocó for the first time.

2.o: Allegra receives some good news about Caterina in the present and tells Félix what happened. Allegra tries to make the bracelet work again so she can go back to the past to change her mom's life. Greta has a plan to sabotage Caterina so she can get the main role in the 1994 play.

3.o: Caterina goes back to her home in the present. Cocó, Caterina and Allegra have dinner together for the first time. Caterina finds out that Allegra auditioned again and the dinner ends in disaster.

4.o: Allegra starts making friends with Caterina in 1994. Marco invites her to the concert he's giving with Diego. Cocó forbids Caterina to go to the concert, but she refuses to give in so easily. Caterina confesses her real passion to Allegra.

5.o: Allegra tries to reason with Caterina. Lucía confesses her big secret to Allegra. Caterina confronts Cocó in 1994 and has a fight with Allegra. The three Sharp women have a moment of union in the present.

6.o: Allegra and Lucía organize a special surprise for Caterina. Allegra tries to persuade Caterina to trust her again. Félix and Allegra talk to Diego in the present and investigate what happened during the opening night of the play.

7.o: Allegra persuades Caterina to forgive her and she helps her rehearse to get the main role. All of a sudden, Cocó pays a visit to Allegra in the bookshop and she realizes Cocó never left the country.

8.o: Allegra and Félix talk to Barbara about the opening night. Lucía reveals something to Allegra that puts at risk her relationship with Marco. Allegra and Sofía challenge each other.

9.o: Allegra and Sofía compete in a dance challenge. Félix doesn't hesitate to put his future at risk so that Allegra can fulfill her dream in the present. Allegra surprises everybody with a last-minute change on the opening night of 1994.

10.o: Allegra tries to save Marco and avoid the fight between Caterina and Cocó before she runs out of time. Cocó makes a decision in 1994 that will change her life forever.

1.o: Estranged and out-of-touch, four women in their 40s reunite for a chance to recapture their fame and regain the swagger they had as the Nasty Bitches—their ‘90s group that made them legends in the hip-hop world.

2.o: While Brianna deals with the shattering truths of her marriage, Jill risks losing the safe community she has built for herself when she decides it is time to stop living a lie and comes clean about who she really is. Meanwhile, after a fateful meeting with Cam’ron, Naomi struggles with finally putting herself first

3.o: After a bad concert review, the women come to terms with the fact that their old image and music no longer serve them; and while Naomi struggles to maintain creative control, Brianna argues for a more collaborative group effort. Meanwhile, Eric takes Valeria out to dinner and dancing in hopes of inspiring her creativity. Later, Naomi gets a second chance to prove herself to JoJo

4.o: Brianna faces some unexpected emotions and circumstances in her home life, but she finds support amongst her Queens. Meanwhile, Jill continues to struggle with her romantic relationships, and Naomi grapples with the truth behind the identity of JoJo’s father.

5.o: As Brianna deals with a painful reminder of Jeff’s infidelity, the group hopes a performance at the American Music Awards will solidify their comeback. Meanwhile, after completing treatment at a rehab facility for her addiction issues, Lauren struggles to identify with her alter ego, Lil Muffin.

6.o: As the ladies prepare to shoot their first music video in nearly two decades, Brianna has a hard time maintaining a work-life balance. Meanwhile, Lil Muffin works to reestablish her career, and Jill continues to manage her public image.

7.o: Jill comes clean with the ladies after being invited to collaborate on a track with Wyclef Jean. In addition, Valeria suffers a heart-wrenching betrayal and Eric makes a promise to Jadakiss that he may not be able to keep

8.o: When tragedy strikes the group, the ladies take a moment to reflect on the beginning stages of their friendship in the early ‘90s when a young Brianna, Naomi and Jill first met. Inseparable and determined to make their musical dreams a reality, the girls recognize their common goal of solidifying the decades-long bond that carries through to present-day

9.o: Valeria makes an impulsive decision about her future that stuns the women; and while Lauren deals with an overzealous fan turned up-and-coming rapper, Naomi comes face-to-face with her old rival, Zadie aka Lady Z.

10.o: Putting old rivalries aside, the ladies embark on a new career venture with Zadie, aka “Lady Z.” Meanwhile, Jill faces her past while standing up to her disapproving father and Naomi encourages Zadie to demand justice

11.o: While Eric and Naomi are conflicted on what is best for JoJo’s future as it relates to the entertainment industry, Jill attempts to help a young troubled actor struggling against an overbearing parent. Elsewhere, Valeria fights for an opportunity to lean into her Puerto Rican heritage

12.t: Let the Past Be the Past
12.o: Valeria’s career as a single artist takes off, and Muffin motivates Jill to get back into the recording booth. Meanwhile, Eric confronts his ex-wife to help save the future of Nasty Girl Records.

13.o: As the Queens prepare to be inducted into the Hip Hop Hall of Fame, they cannot help but notice the void Brianna’s absence from the group has left. Meanwhile, Naomi is waylaid when an old beau questions JoJo’s paternity. Elsewhere, Valeria gets ready to embark on her solo tour and she wonders if she really is ready to go at it alone.

1.o: Diego de la Vega returns to California to avenge his father’s murder. After assuming the title of Zorro, he initiates his struggle against Nah-Lin, a Native American who he believes has stolen his inheritance. Diego will confront the Governor, the malevolent leader of the Chinese community and a secret society, placing the common good above all. In doing so, he will sacrifice his love for Lola.

2.o: To attract Zorro's attention, Diego and Lolita are held hostage in a robbery at the loan office. Lolita gets injured and Diego questions whether he is up to the task of wearing the mask.

3.o: A woman is missing in Chinatown, calling Zorro to take action. Matters get worse with the unfortunate explosion at the Ramirez mine. Additionally, Diego learns the painful news of the murder of his father.

4.o: Zorro is instilling fear in an open war against the governor. Lolita is torn by her emotions for Diego while Monasterio unveils something about Zorro that is going to change everything.

5.o: Monasterio suspects that Zorro is not what the governor claims him to be. Diego and Nah-Lin feel forced to leave behind their differences and strike a truce to free the captured indigenous people. Diego uncovers a crucial clue to find his father’s murderers.

6.o: The auction for Ramirez’s lands seems to have a pre-fixed winner: The Russo-American company. Right after attempting to avoid Andreyévich from making the auction, Diego is surprised by the visit of the Bear Clan. Lolita is confused with her feelings for Diego and her engagement with Monasterio.

7.o: Accounts of Zorro appear in The Californian, which helps Ivanova find the missing piece to her plans. Diego gets a final warning from one of Nah-Lin's men that puts at risk his secret identity.

8.o: Nah-Lin discovers that Lolita is Diego’s weakness, so she threatens to kill her on her weeding day if he doesn’t give up being Zorro.

9.o: The Bear Clan asks Diego for a loyalty test. If he wants to prevent it, he must uncover the murderers before the established deadline. Lolita confronts Diego about Zorro’s identity.

10.o: Guadalupe and Samael arrive in Los Angeles to claim part of Alejandro’s inheritance. The deadline is almost over: Diego must kill Monasterio.

1.o: Oh Wan-soo, head of NOW Foundation, becomes the target of a shooting while on the way to a fundraiser. Do-yoon, who is investigating his friend's death, comes to her rescue.

2.o: Wan-soo witnesses a shocking scene during the fundraiser. After getting intoxicated, she unexpectedly approaches Do-yoon.

3.o: Wan-soo refuses to divorce Yongkook, while Tae-ra stands firm beside him. Tensions escalate as the day of the Hwain Group family's photoshoot nears. During the photoshoot, Miran replaces Wan-soo's deceased son with Yongkook's illegitimate child.

4.o: Do-yoon worries for Wan-soo's safety as she holds a press conference regarding Hwain Group. He warns that the shooter who targeted her in Manila is within Hwain Group.

5.o: Wan-soo departs with Do-yoon after her mother's death. Meanwhile, Do-yoon investigates "Palseongbok," a key location regarding the Hwain Group's slush fund.

6.o: While returning from the welfare center, Do-yoon narrowly saves Wan-soo's life from an explosion. Wan-soo asks for Do-yoon's help to retrieve the original copy of the NOW Foundation's ledger to catch the culprit within Hwain Group.

7.o: Wan-soo's brother gets arrested for embezzlement. Wan-soo visits Busan under Do-yoon's protection, but faces another attack.

8.o: Furious over the scandal fabricated by his mother, Yong-kook vents his long-standing anger at his mother. Meanwhile, the former chairman's will is disclosed, shocking everyone.

9.o: The former chairman's will sparks a clash. Meanwhile, Wan-soo's brother gets into an accident while Mi-ran faces a prosecution summons. The mysteries surrounding the former chairman's death unravel.

10.o: Mi-ran goes into custody. Meanwhile, a shooting takes place, and Wan-soo is implicated as a suspect. The mastermind behind it all is revealed.

1.o: A modest taxi driver comes across a mysterious nursing home for the ultrarich — but soon discovers that it's hiding a sinister secret.

2.o: A couple living in poverty adopts an orphan with the uncanny ability to bring them wealth in six days. But on the seventh day, grave danger awaits.

3.o: While struggling to complete her latest novel, an author finds that her life is mirroring that of her main character.

4.o: Facing eviction, a community of fishermen seeks answers from a withdrawn man who captures a photograph of a mysterious object in the night sky.

5.o: A man's detour to an abandoned movie theater where he once worked ends up having an irreversible impact on his life.

6.o: Desperate to earn a living, an electronics technician learns to hypnotize other people but soon faces the consequences of his actions.

7.o: A professional diamond appraiser searching for her missing sister follows clues that lead her into a deadly situation.

1.o: تنتشر مقاطع تعرض محاولة "سايمون غرين" العنيفة لإعادة ابنته الهاربة إلى المنزل، فيما يستعين أب يائس آخر بالمحققة الخاصة "إلينا رافنسكروفت" في البحث عن ابنه.

2.o: يُنقل آل "غرين" إلى المستشفى حيث يصبح "سايمون" في مواجهة مع الشرطة، وتكتشف "إلينا" وجود صلة بين "هنري" وشخص آخر مفقود.

3.o: تتلقى "ماريا" زيارة غير مرغوب فيها من "إلينا" خلال وقت متأخر من الليل، ويحضر "سايمون" مراسم تأبين على مضض فيعرف أخبارًا مقلقة عن "بايج".
